tasks.title: Swap type to Newsreader + IBM Plex Mono
acceptance_criteria: index.html <link> loads Newsreader (ital,opsz,wght axes) and IBM Plex Mono (400;500;600) with display=swap; the old Instrument Serif / JetBrains Mono link is gone
Every occurrence of 'Instrument Serif' is replaced by 'Newsreader' with a Georgia, serif fallback
Every occurrence of 'JetBrains Mono' is replaced by 'IBM Plex Mono' with a ui-monospace, monospace fallback
body font-family in index.css uses Newsreader; no layout/color/spacing values change
tests: grep proves zero remaining 'Instrument Serif' / 'JetBrains Mono' references in src and index.html
index.html requests exactly Newsreader + IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts
build succeeds and the page renders text in the new families (manual/visual)

tasks.title: Add motion CSS primitives + reduced-motion/print guards
acceptance_criteria: index.css defines .reveal / .reveal.in (opacity+translateY, cubic-bezier ~0.8s) and stagger delays d1..d4
index.css defines .bar-fill (scaleX 0, transform-origin left) with .reveal.in .bar-fill -> scaleX(1), and .dot pop-in
@keyframes drift + .sky ambient class defined (behind the include-sky decision)
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) forces .reveal/.bar-fill/.dot to final visible state and disables drift
@media print forces .reveal opacity:1/transform:none and gauge/dot final state so printed output is never blank
tests: reduced-motion query renders all reveal elements at opacity 1 with no transition (manual/DOM)
build succeeds with the new CSS

tasks.title: Reveal + CountUp motion components
acceptance_criteria: Reveal renders a chosen element with class 'reveal' and toggles 'in' via IntersectionObserver when it enters the viewport; supports an optional stagger/delay and inline-delay style; unobserves after firing; idempotent under StrictMode
CountUp owns its own RAF animation from 0 to `to` with ease-out, appends `suffix`, and its final text equals Math.round(to)+suffix
Both honor prefers-reduced-motion: Reveal starts 'in', CountUp shows final value immediately, no RAF loop
CountUp survives a parent re-render without resetting or blanking its value
tests: CountUp final rendered text equals the previous static value for representative temps/percentages
under reduced motion Reveal has class in on mount and CountUp shows final value with no animation
observer is cleaned up on unmount (no leak / no double-fire)

tasks.title: Wire motion into the bulletin page
acceptance_criteria: Masthead, hero, list header, each almanac row, the note, and footer are wrapped in Reveal with a staggered delay matching Option A
Hero min/max and stat values, and each almanac row min/max, render via CountUp (values unchanged from today)
Each almanac row temperature bar uses .bar-fill so it draws from the left as the row reveals
The two hero thermometer endpoint dots use .dot so they pop in after the hero reveals
Hero ambient background uses the drifting .sky (behind the include-sky decision); no other hero visuals change
No layout, color, spacing, or copy change; empty/loading/error states and admin are untouched
tests: rendered temperatures/stats match the pre-change values (count-up endpoints correct)
with reduced motion the page is fully visible and static and identical in content
scrolling reveals rows and draws gauges (manual/visual)

out_of_scope: Any layout, spacing, radius, color, or copy change
Print-pipeline changes beyond keeping print static and visible
New iconography or the prototype's mark/disc hero treatment
